title: Convolutional Neural Network
body:
Pointer note. **[[CNN]] is the real note**, and it carries the acronym as its filename because that
is what everything actually says.

The spelled-out name is worth having written down once, because the word is **convolutional**, from
the convolution operation (slide a filter over the input and take a [[Dot Product]] at each
position), not *convoluted*, which means tangled and complicated. This file was originally named
the second way. The two words are unrelated.

See [[CNN]] for local connectivity, weight sharing, pooling, and why it beats a flat
[[Multilayer Perceptron]] on images.

Added 2026-08-16: the operation this network is named for is defined in [[Convolution Theorem]]
([[FOURIER AND COMPLEX ANALYSIS]], MATH 4199). The mathematical fact worth carrying across is that
convolution in one domain is pointwise multiplication in the other, which is why large-kernel
filtering is done through the [[Fast Fourier Transform]]. Small learned kernels like these are
cheaper computed directly.
